meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用命令行创建、预览和发布动画视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想用简单的命令制作和分享动画视频。
copy.tagline_en: Create, preview, and publish animated videos with a command-line tool.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to create and share animated videos using simple commands.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会用一套名叫 HyperFrames 的命令行工具帮你制作视频：先初始化项目，搜索并加入现成的动画效果，检查画面、预览时间线，最后渲染成 MP4 文件；遇到构建或渲染失败时，它也会用这套工具来诊断问题。
howto.when: 当你想制作或编辑视频、查询动画效果，或遇到构建/渲染失败时，Claude 会进入 HyperFrames 命令行工作流来帮你处理。

say.text: 帮我用 HyperFrames 做一个视频，先初始化项目。
say.note: Claude 会运行 init 创建项目骨架。

say.text: 这个视频渲染失败了，帮我诊断一下。
say.note: Claude 会运行 doctor 等命令排查问题。

say.text: 用 catalog 搜索一个逐行显示标题的效果。
say.note: Claude 会在本地目录中查找现成动画。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use the HyperFrames command-line tool to make videos: initialize projects, search and add ready-made motion primitives, lint and check compositions, preview timelines, and render MP4s; it also uses the tool to diagnose build or render failures.
howto.when_en: When you want to create or edit a video, search motion effects, or hit build/render failures, Claude enters the HyperFrames CLI workflow.

say_en.text: Make a video with HyperFrames, start by initializing a project.
say_en.note: Claude will run init to scaffold it.

say_en.text: This render failed; help me diagnose it.
say_en.note: Claude will use doctor and related commands.

say_en.text: Use catalog to find a reveal-headline-line-by-line primitive.
say_en.note: Claude searches the local catalog for a ready-made move.
